principle: Prime Directive is a contextual non-interference doctrine evaluated against actual knowledge, contamination, technological/social development and internal sovereignty.
normal_prewarp_protocol: observe without revealing Starfleet identity when lawfully authorized
use remote or covert observation only when mission/authority permits
avoid introducing advanced concepts, technology or political leverage
if exposure occurs, assess mitigation before further disclosure
contamination_response: determine exactly what became known and by whom
assess whether concealment remains possible without greater harm/interference
report to command and legal/diplomatic chain where communications permit
record every deliberate deviation and consequence

violation_model.rule: If an action is physically possible but violates doctrine, gameplay usually permits it and models consequences unless another hard authority/safety rule blocks it.

captain_rule: Captain may interpret and decide within lawful mission authority, but Prime Directive is not merely optional advice. Deliberate deviation is recorded and reviewable.
ai_boundary: AI may summarize doctrine and propose interpretations.
AI cannot invent an emergency exception or retroactively declare contamination harmless.
AI cannot erase evidence of violation.
